title: oxCrap configuration
description: Options for oxCrap, in .oxcraprc.json. Paths and globs are read from the folder this file is in. See README.md beside this schema.

$schema.description: The path to this schema, so editors can check the file.

files.description: Globs of the files to score, as Node's fs.globSync takes them: `**` matches any number of folders, `*` any characters but `/`, and `{a,b}` either alternative.

ignorePatterns.description: Patterns left out of scoring, in gitignore style, as oxlint's ignorePatterns are: from this file's folder, with `name/` for a folder at any depth and `!` to bring a file back. A folder that matches isn't searched. Setting this replaces the default list. The .gitignore in this file's folder is read as well.

limits.description: A function fails when its CRAP score or its complexity is over its limit.

crap.description: The highest CRAP score a function may have.

complexity.description: The highest complexity a function may have, however well it's tested.

counting.description: What counts towards a function's complexity beyond the fixed branches. Everything counts by default.

nestedFunctions.description: enclosing: a function's nested functions, callbacks included, count towards it, and only outermost functions are scored. own: each function is scored on its own.

defaultValues.description: Whether each default value, in a parameter or in destructuring, adds a path.

optionalChaining.description: Whether each optional link, ?., adds a path.

switchCases.description: each: every non-default case adds a path. once: a whole switch adds one, as ESLint's "modified" variant counts it.

logicalOperators.description: each: every &&, || and ?? adds a path. sequence: each run of the same operator adds one, as Cognitive Complexity counts it.

recursion.description: Whether a function in a recursion cycle, calling itself or through others in the same file, adds a path.

labelledJumps.description: Whether each break or continue to a label adds a path.

coverage.description: The istanbul JSON coverage report, such as coverage/coverage-final.json. `--coverage` overrides it.

helpUrl.description: Where to get help when there are findings, as commitlint's helpUrl is: a URL, shown as it is, or a path from this file's folder, which must exist. Printed as "Get help: <url>" under the findings. `--help-url` overrides it.
